LanguageData.Hediff_SSC_PersonalityExcreting.label: Preparing Personality Excretion
LanguageData.Hediff_SSC_PersonalityExcreting.descript: NPA injected through the anus begins to work, collecting the target's personality (soul) and preparing excretion.
LanguageData.Hediff_SSC_PersonalityExcreted_Done.desc: Personality has been emptied while retaining all memories (without affecting the current initial personality). The PNA-created initial personality now handles life activities, while the original personality gel still shares sensation with the body.
